name: Jira
description: Trigger workflows when a Jira Cloud issue is created, updated or moved to a status, and create, edit, transition, comment on, assign, read or search issues from a step.

triggers.label: An issue is created
triggers.description: Fires once for each issue created since the last poll, oldest first, within the project and JQL filter from the settings.

env.name: JIRA_SITE_URL
env.description: Your Jira Cloud site, such as https://example.atlassian.net.
env.builderHint: Only the origin is kept: a trailing slash or a path is dropped and /rest/api/3 appended. A mistyped site answers 200 with an HTML login page, which the connector reports as a non-JSON answer.

env.name: JIRA_EMAIL
env.description: The email address of the Atlassian account the API token belongs to.
env.builderHint: The user half of HTTP Basic auth: Authorization: Basic base64(email + ":" + apiToken) on every call.

env.name: JIRA_API_TOKEN
env.description: An API token from https://id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens, created without scopes. Every issue created or comment posted is attributed to this account.
env.builderHint: The password half of Basic auth. A token created "with scopes" only works against api.atlassian.com/ex/jira/{cloudId} and answers 401 on the site URL. A 401 is never retried: repeated failures trip a CAPTCHA that blocks the API until the person logs in through the browser.

env.name: JIRA_PROJECT_KEY
env.description: Limit the triggers to one project, by key (EX). Blank watches every project the account can browse.
env.builderHint: Adds `project = <KEY>` in front of every trigger's JQL; letters, digits and underscores only, so it cannot carry JQL of its own.

env.name: JIRA_JQL
env.description: An extra JQL filter every trigger applies, such as issuetype = Bug AND priority in (High, Highest).
env.builderHint: ANDed in parentheses after the time clause, so ORs inside it stay together; leave out ORDER BY, the trigger adds its own.

env.name: JIRA_STATUS
env.description: The status name the issueTransitioned trigger watches for, such as Done. Only that trigger reads it.
env.builderHint: Quoted into `status CHANGED TO "<status>" AFTER "<cursor>"`; the name is matched by Jira, not here.

triggers.label: An issue is updated
triggers.description: Fires for each change to an issue since the last poll, keyed by issue and update time, so an issue edited twice fires twice.

actions.label: Create an issue
actions.description: Create one issue in a project. The description is written as plain text and converted to Atlassian Document Format.

inputs.label: Project
inputs.description: The project key, such as EX.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as fields.project.key; the account needs Create issues in that project or the call answers 403.

inputs.label: Issue type
inputs.description: The issue type name: Bug, Task, Story, Epic or Subtask.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as fields.issuetype.name and matched by Jira against the project's issue type scheme; an unknown name answers 400 naming issuetype in errors.

inputs.label: Summary
inputs.description: The one-line summary.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as fields.summary; required by every default screen.

inputs.label: Description
inputs.description: The description as plain text; blank lines start new paragraphs. An ADF document as JSON is sent as it is.
inputs.builderHint: Converted to Atlassian Document Format ({ version: 1, type: "doc", content: [paragraph…] }) because v3 refuses plain text; a value that parses as JSON with type "doc" is passed through.

inputs.label: Assignee account id
inputs.description: The account id of the assignee, from getCurrentUser or the issue's assignee output.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as fields.assignee.id; names and emails are not accepted here, only account ids.

inputs.label: Labels
inputs.description: Comma-separated labels, such as bugfix,triaged. Labels cannot contain spaces.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as the fields.labels array; a label with a space is refused before the call.

inputs.label: Priority
inputs.description: The priority name: Highest, High, Medium, Low or Lowest.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as fields.priority.name; the reference's own 400 example is "Field 'priority' is required" on a project whose screen demands it.

inputs.label: Parent issue
inputs.description: The parent issue key, for a subtask or a child of an epic.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as fields.parent.key; a Subtask issue type needs one.

inputs.label: Fields
inputs.description: A JSON object of issue fields to set as well, keyed by field id, such as {"customfield_10000":"value","duedate":"2026-09-30"}.
inputs.builderHint: Merged over the named inputs into the request body's `fields`; a field the screen does not carry answers 400 with the field named in `errors`.

outputs.description: The issue key, such as EX-12
The REST URL of the issue

actions.label: Update an issue
actions.description: Edit the summary, description or any fields of an issue; the rest stays as it was. Transitions are ignored here, use transitionIssue.

inputs.label: Issue
inputs.description: The issue key (EX-12) or id.
inputs.builderHint: Sent URL-encoded as the {issueIdOrKey} path segment; a key that no longer matches is looked up case-insensitively and across moves by Jira itself, and an unknown one answers 404.

inputs.label: Summary
inputs.description: A new summary line.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as fields.summary when set.

inputs.label: Description
inputs.description: The description as plain text; blank lines start new paragraphs. An ADF document as JSON is sent as it is.
inputs.builderHint: Converted to Atlassian Document Format ({ version: 1, type: "doc", content: [paragraph…] }) because v3 refuses plain text; a value that parses as JSON with type "doc" is passed through.

inputs.label: Fields
inputs.description: A JSON object of issue fields to set, keyed by field id, such as {"customfield_10000":"value","duedate":"2026-09-30"}.
inputs.builderHint: Merged over the named inputs into the request body's `fields`; a field the screen does not carry answers 400 with the field named in `errors`.

inputs.label: Update operations
inputs.description: A JSON object of update operations, such as {"labels":[{"add":"triaged"}]} or {"components":[{"remove":{"name":"UI"}}]}.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as the body's `update`; a field may appear in `fields` or `update`, not both, or Jira answers 400.

inputs.label: Notify users
inputs.description: Send the usual edit notifications. Defaults to true; false needs project administer permission or is ignored.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as notifyUsers=false on the query only when set to false.

outputs.description: The issue key, such as EX-12
The issue after the edit, as Jira returns it

actions.label: Transition an issue
actions.description: Move an issue through a workflow transition, by transition id or name, optionally with a comment and screen fields.

inputs.label: Issue
inputs.description: The issue key (EX-12) or id.
inputs.builderHint: Sent URL-encoded as the {issueIdOrKey} path segment; a key that no longer matches is looked up case-insensitively and across moves by Jira itself, and an unknown one answers 404.

inputs.label: Transition
inputs.description: A transition id (31) or name (Done). A name is matched against the transitions the issue offers, then against their target statuses.
inputs.builderHint: Digits are sent as transition.id as they are; anything else is resolved case-insensitively against GET issue/{key}/transitions by name, then by to.name. When that list names nothing the value is sent as the id and Jira's own answer stands; when it names transitions and none match, the error lists them.

inputs.label: Comment
inputs.description: A plain-text comment to add with the transition.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as update.comment[0].add.body in ADF, the documented way to comment on a transition.

inputs.label: Fields
inputs.description: A JSON object of fields the transition screen asks for, such as {"resolution":{"name":"Done"}}.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as the body's `fields`; only fields on the transition screen are accepted.

outputs.description: The issue key or id that was transitioned
The transition name, when it was resolved
The status the issue moved to, when known

actions.label: Add a comment
actions.description: Post a comment on an issue. Plain text is converted to Atlassian Document Format.

inputs.label: Issue
inputs.description: The issue key (EX-12) or id.
inputs.builderHint: Sent URL-encoded as the {issueIdOrKey} path segment; a key that no longer matches is looked up case-insensitively and across moves by Jira itself, and an unknown one answers 404.

inputs.label: Comment
inputs.description: The comment as plain text; blank lines start new paragraphs. An ADF document as JSON is sent as it is.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as `body` in ADF on POST issue/{key}/comment; the account needs Add comments on the project.

outputs.description: { accountId, displayName } of the account that posted it
The REST URL of the comment

actions.label: Assign an issue
actions.description: Assign an issue to an account, or unassign it.

inputs.label: Issue
inputs.description: The issue key (EX-12) or id.
inputs.builderHint: Sent URL-encoded as the {issueIdOrKey} path segment; a key that no longer matches is looked up case-insensitively and across moves by Jira itself, and an unknown one answers 404.

inputs.label: Account id
inputs.description: The assignee's account id. Blank or null unassigns; -1 assigns the project's default assignee.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as { accountId } on PUT issue/{key}/assignee, with null for unassigned as the reference documents.

outputs.description: The account id now assigned, or null

actions.label: Get an issue
actions.description: Read one issue by key or id, with its main fields flattened and the description as plain text.

inputs.label: Issue
inputs.description: The issue key (EX-12) or id.
inputs.builderHint: Sent URL-encoded as the {issueIdOrKey} path segment; a key that no longer matches is looked up case-insensitively and across moves by Jira itself, and an unknown one answers 404.

inputs.label: Fields
inputs.description: Comma-separated field ids to return, such as summary,status,customfield_10000. Defaults to every navigable field.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as the `fields` query parameter; *navigable is the default here because the API's own default is only `id`.

outputs.description: The issue key, such as EX-12
Status name, such as In Progress
The status category: To Do, In Progress or Done
Resolution name, or null while open
The description flattened to plain text
The issue as Jira returns it, fields included

actions.label: Search issues
actions.description: Run a JQL query and return the matching issues, paging until maxResults are collected.

inputs.label: JQL
inputs.description: A JQL expression, such as project = EX AND status = "In Progress" ORDER BY updated DESC.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as `jql` on GET search/jql, which needs a bounded query; a bare ORDER BY is prefixed with created >= "1970-01-01" so it is accepted.

inputs.label: Fields
inputs.description: Comma-separated field ids to return. Defaults to summary, status, issue type, priority, assignee, reporter, project, labels, created, updated and resolution.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as `fields`; the API returns only `id` when it is left out, so the default list is always sent.

inputs.label: Maximum results
inputs.description: How many issues to return in total, 1 to 5000. Defaults to 50.
inputs.builderHint: Pages of up to 100 are walked with nextPageToken until this many are collected or the last page arrives, at most ten pages per call.

outputs.description: One entry per issue in the getIssue shape: id, key, url, summary, status, …
True when no further page exists
The token for the next page, when the walk stopped before the end

actions.label: List transitions
actions.description: The workflow transitions an issue can take from its current status.

inputs.label: Issue
inputs.description: The issue key (EX-12) or id.
inputs.builderHint: Sent URL-encoded as the {issueIdOrKey} path segment; a key that no longer matches is looked up case-insensitively and across moves by Jira itself, and an unknown one answers 404.

outputs.description: One entry per transition: id, name, to { id, name, statusCategory }, hasScreen, isAvailable
How many transitions the issue offers

actions.label: List projects
actions.description: The projects the account can browse, ordered by key, optionally filtered by a name or key fragment and by type.

inputs.label: Query
inputs.description: Return only projects whose key or name contains this text, case-insensitively.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as `query` on GET project/search.

inputs.label: Project type
inputs.description: Limit to one project type. Blank returns every type.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as `typeKey` when set; the API also accepts a comma-separated list.

outputs.description: One entry per project: id, key, name, projectTypeKey, simplified, style, url

actions.label: Get the current user
actions.description: The account the API token belongs to, with its account id and time zone.

outputs.description: The account id, as assignee fields take it
The email address, when the account does not hide it
The account's time zone, which JQL dates are read in
The REST URL of the user
